## Project Overview

Through my graduate coursework at Cal Poly Pomona, I have applied marketing research methodologies to better understand consumer behavior, purchasing decisions, and customer engagement.

## Research Activities

- Developed marketing research questions.
- Designed survey measures and questionnaires.
- Applied consumer behavior concepts.
- Used analytical frameworks to organize research.
- Communicated research findings and recommendations.

## Tools and Skills

Qualtrics, Marketing Research, Consumer Analytics, Survey Design, and Data Analysis.

## Learning Outcomes

This work strengthened my ability to develop research questions, evaluate consumer behavior, and support marketing decisions using structured research methods.
